localPolicy: Record incoming champion mark eligibility when the existing local Q mark pulse is accepted, before delayed first damage.
Keep mark-only assist history separate from damage history and execution kill attribution.
Reuse the existing inclusive standard assist window, one-hop support eligibility and awarded-takedown Highlander callback.
Do not infer target-area vision, source effects/audio or an assist-gold formula from this behavior lead.
